description.value: Benjamin's Cafe is a family-run Filipino restaurant that opened in 2023, bringing authentic dishes like adobo, bulalo, lumpia, and halo-halo to Victoria. Founded by owners with generational roots in Philippine culinary tradition, the restaurant is built around the cultural values of warmth and hospitality. Cyclists in the western part of Victoria will find a welcoming spot for a hearty, home-style meal far from the tourist core.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 42m; rack at 59m; rack (1 space) at 82m; rack (3 spaces) at 87m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM address ('614B Grenville Ave. Victoria, BC V9A 6L2'), phone ('1 (778) 265-2566'), and operating status. The services page explicitly lists dine-in and three third-party delivery/takeout platforms, confirming takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Filipino restaurant with a confirmed website, matching contact details, and active delivery platform partnerships. A useful stop for touring cyclists in western Victoria.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business email (benjaminrodneybright@gmail.com) is visible on the contact page but not present in the OSM record; not a concern, just additional contact info available.
